scope: Independent review of the unpublished tab geometry repair on base 26e80ae9. No native runtime success is inferred from this source review.
verdict: Accepted for the next native acceptance run. The measured absolute bar now lies inside its nonzero parent bounds, while natural-flow bars retain natural layout.

independentFocusedVerification.executed: Earlier in this review session after the nonfloating fallback correction; final source hashes rechecked when recording this receipt.
independentFocusedVerification.mechanism: Actual TSX component and installed React Native flattenStyle with controlled React effects/native hosts; not a UIKit/Android accessibility runtime.

reviewedProperties: Finite numeric floating height and nonnegative bottom give an absolute parent of height + bottom, retaining the shown bar screen position and full content height.
The descriptor is read for the focused route on every render; array flattening, safe-area and focused-style changes are covered.
keepVisible retains the same bounds while omitting animated transforms and resetting previous motion state.
pointerEvents remains box-none and BottomTabBar props, labels and event handlers remain unchanged.
Default or relative styles leave the wrapper frame undefined and preserve natural flow; only absolute unmeasurable styles use the full parent frame.
Scroll hide/reveal and effect cleanup use the existing native-driver animation configuration.
resolvedDuringReview: Full-fill fallback initially also applied to default/relative bars; this would alter natural-flow layout. Owner restricted it to absolute custom styles and added a regression.

geometryEvidence.description: Owner compiled installed React Native Yoga source and reproduced zero-height before/nonzero enclosing after bounds for four viewport/safe-area cases. This is separate evidence, not independently repeated here.

limitations: The unchanged scale/translate configuration has a different pivot after parent height becomes nonzero; exact pixel motion trajectory is not preserved. At 108pt parent height and 0.92 scale, pivot contribution can differ by 4.32pt.
No completed post-repair Simulator/Emulator run is claimed. Next acceptance must discover and tap tabs through their existing semantic labels.
The full-frame fallback encloses unusual absolute custom bars but does not infer their exact dimensions.
